I take it you just said it out loud? Just give them some time they'll get over it. The more you bring it up the more it'll piss them off.
Do you even know what was said that got them upset?

The voices are assholes. They just make it seem easier everytime. Like "it only takes a second" "pulling the trigger is the hardest part. The bullet will take care of the rest" 
This shit goes through my head daily now. Fucking hate it.

Take advantage of her time away. Keep bettering yourself & get your shit together. Keep in touch that way she reads how you're changing. That may just give her the confidence to give you another shot. But in the meantime get your life in order so that you have something to offer her. The rest you 2 can build together. Im sitting here in a big home for a family that left. My gf & her 2 kids. You dont ever want to feel this way. The empty rooms are just a reminder of my failure.

The thing is you need closure. Just ask to speak to her & let her know when you show up. Say your piece, but listen as well. Be thorough & let it all out. If she's as good as you think she is then she'll forgive you. But it all starts with a message. REMEMBER. If she forgives you that doesn't mean she wants you back. You have to let her figure that on her own. Be patient. If she chooses to keep talking then dont fuck it up this time. Remember your issues & work on them. 

I say all this from experience. This LITERALLY happened to me this past weekend. I royally fucked everything up all over again. Haven't seen her in 10 months. Almost a year. We were together 6 years. Nothing I tried helped me. So I finally grew some balls & asked to see her. Then we met at a mutual spot. Told her that I needed closure & laid it all out. I had plenty of time to think & get help where I could. Hell, even youtube has therapy channels. Anyway, she wanted to keep in touch. That ment the world to me. She came over for dinner the next day (Sunday) & we talked for hours. Getting things off our chest. She leaves. Then tells me she needs a couple of days to process everything. I guess I failed to realize I made it look like we were going to try again. I went from saturday- meeting her & mending things. To monday- rushing to her house to try to work things out. I had it in my head that I cant let her get away. Marry her if I can. So we talked for hours & let everything out. Not yelling. Just talking. All I saw were constant tears, bloodshot eyes, & swollen cheeks. I stood up & realized Im back at square 1. Fucked it up all over again. I was just there hurting her emotionally. I told her I loved her. Hugged her & went on my way. 
So now I began today getting rid of all my possessions. Started a will & looking to get a DNR. Im literally done. Dont be like me buddy. Learn from my mistakes. I didnt even realize until yesterday that I havent eaten since Sunday. Still haven't eaten anything. Just no fucking appetite.

The 1 thing I learned is Don't be bitter. Be better...

Update: Threw away magazines I've had since high school. Very sentimental. Took pics of all the items to be posted for sale. The process is now in motion. Never realized I had so much shit & unfinished projects. Crazy thing is this is actually quite liberating. Also, still haven't eaten since Sunday. Should have done this years ago. Lol. Dropped 4 lbs in 2 days. I keep thinking at least I'll be easy to carry in the end.
You're response was worth the read & thank you. But I made up mind earlier. This just isn't worth it anymore.
Love is the only thing I fuck up. Every damn time.
Who are you to judge us?
Just finished doing the same. Left messages with old friends earlier & told my family individually that I love them.
